news.title: No tax on value of new property under redevelopment agreement: ITAT
news.para: A tax tribunal has sided with property owners involved in redevelopment disagreements, annulling a significant Rs 1.3 crore tax increment on a newly developed property. The tribunal emphasized that taxation under Section 56(2)(x) applies only when the property is actualized, meaning it cannot be taxed while still under construction. This ruling provides crucial tax relief for homeowners navigating complex redevelopment contracts.

news.title: Rajasthan HC issues notice to government over rent control act provisions
news.para: The Rajasthan High Court has served notices to the state government and relevant parties following a tenant's challenge against specific provisions of the Rajasthan Rent Control Act, 2001. The tenant contended that the current system leads to excessive delays in resolving disputes. With the landlord having cut off electricity, the tenant aimed to have it restored.

news.title: From two-year stay to 12-year wait: Delhi’s Kathputli Colony families await homes
news.para: Thousands of families displaced from Kathputli Colony await permanent homes after twelve years.  These families were moved to Anand Parbat in 2014 with a two-year rehabilitation promise.  The transit camp has deteriorated significantly, causing hardship for residents.  The Delhi Development Authority and a private developer are in a dispute over maintenance charges.  Residents continue to hope for the completion of their promised housing project.

news.title: CBI report flags deviations from DLF Primus brochure plan in Gurugram: SC
news.para: The Supreme Court pointed out significant variances from the original concept of DLF Primus, with a critical 24-meter corridor largely absent from the project. Much of the area is dedicated to landscaped spaces and resident parking. Consequently, the court has urged the CBI to promptly advance its preliminary inquiry and requires the Haryana government to ensure that future constructions meet legal requirements.

news.title: Punjab & Haryana HC gives relief to IT City plot allottees in Mohali
news.para: The Punjab and Haryana High Court has set aside Gmada's additional demand for plot allottees. This demand was raised from residential plot allottees in Sector 83 Alpha under the IT City Scheme. The court found that the demand notice violated principles of natural justice and due process. Gmada can issue a fresh demand after following the correct legal procedures.

news.title: Credai-Gujarat seeks GST clarity on FSI purchases
news.para: Credai Gujarat is urging state government officials for clear guidance regarding GST on FSI (Floor Space Index) charges. Developers are advocating for significant tax reforms, specifically aiming to redefine affordable housing and works contracts. They suggest adopting RERA carpet area standards as eligible criteria for affordable housing. Furthermore, reducing GST on works contracts stands out as a primary demand. These initiatives are intended to enhance housing supply and assist homebuyers.

news.title: Maharashtra housing federation seeks clearer rules on parking, dues & redevelopment in draft model bylaws
news.para: The Maharashtra housing federation is advocating for revisions to the proposed model bylaws governing societies. They request more explicit definitions of administrators' powers and enhanced voting rights. Additionally, the federation seeks to synchronize the bylaws with RERA and contemporary cooperative legislation. Their suggestions emphasize straightforward procedures aimed at minimizing disputes among members, ultimately aspiring to create an effective governance model.

news.title: Bombay high court stays further demolition in Rustomjee Crown flats
news.para: The Bombay High Court has intervened, putting a stop to the BMC's demolition activities. Residents at Rustomjee Crown contended that they have been promised exclusive access to foyer areas by the developer. The court has granted a temporary reprieve from demolitions until September 16, allowing the residents' concerns to be addressed thoroughly.

news.title: Prepare action plan to develop satellite townships in urbanised districts: Jharkhand CM to officials
news.para: Chief Minister Hemant Soren of Jharkhand has instructed officials to formulate a strategy for the creation of satellite townships. This endeavor seeks to broaden urban development by focusing on more than just physical infrastructure. The action plan will explore land use, essential infrastructure, and anticipated demographic trends, striving to cultivate organized and advanced urban settings for inhabitants.

news.title: Aditya Birla Group enters wires and cables business with ₹1,800 crore investment
news.para: Aditya Birla Group has entered the wires and cables business with Ultravolt, housed under UltraTech Cement. Backed by an investment of ₹1,800 crore, the business aims to become one of the top two players in the segment within five years.

news.title: Mumbai: Shripad Developers's owner accused of selling flat to two persons arrested after three years
news.para: After three years on the run, a Mumbai builder has been apprehended for allegedly defrauding a businessman of Rs 83.34 lakh. The charges stem from his deceit in reselling a flat that had already been purchased by another buyer between January and March 2020. Authorities are now deepening their investigation into this fraudulent scheme.

news.title: CBI files 19th chargesheet against Earthcon Universal Infratech in 'banker-builder nexus' case
news.para: The Central Bureau of Investigation has filed a chargesheet against Earthcon Universal Infratech directors. This case involves a housing project in Greater Noida where homebuyers were allegedly cheated. The agency uncovered substantial evidence of criminal conspiracy and cheating by the builder. This investigation is part of a larger probe into a banker-builder nexus. Thousands of homebuyers were reportedly defrauded through false assurances and deceptive practices.

news.title: Prestige Group acquires 17.14 acre land parcel in Gurugram
news.para: Prestige Group's proposed project in sector 109 Gurugram will have a saleable area of approximately 2.8 million sq ft, with an estimated gross development value (GDV) of approximately ₹5,600 crore.

news.title: Mumbai: MMRDA aims to complete ongoing infrastructure projects by December 2028
news.para: MMRDA is targeting completion of its ongoing infrastructure projects by December 2028, ahead of the December 2029 deadline. The authority is developing roads, tunnels, sea links, metro corridors and regional connectivity projects to improve mobility across the Mumbai Metropolitan Region.

news.title: Maharashtra targets $1.5 trillion economy for Mumbai metropolitan region by 2047: CM
news.para: Maharashtra chief minister Devendra Fadnavis said Mumbai 3.0 has moved from vision to execution, with redevelopment, new airports, Vadhavan Port, metro and coastal road projects, data centres, smart manufacturing and AI-led governance expected to reshape the state’s urban economy.

news.title: Vasai-Virar ex-town planning official denied bail in ED money laundering case
news.para: A special court denied bail to Y Shiva Reddy, a former town planning official, deeming that evidence suggests he was in possession of significant illegal assets. In a related case, builder Arun Gupta's bail request was also turned down. The Enforcement Directorate linked these proceedings to allegations of land grabbing and illegal permissions, resulting in the demolition of 41 structures and displacing numerous families.

news.title: Visakhapatnam: Velampeta families agree to shift temporarily for new housing complex
news.para: Residents will temporarily relocate to rented homes for a new housing complex.  The Greater Visakhapatnam Municipal Corporation will build apartment blocks at the existing settlement.  Each family will receive a free 410 sq ft flat with basic facilities.  Rental assistance of Rs 3,000 per month will be provided until construction concludes.  This project offers a permanent solution to housing issues for 177 families.

news.title: Ahmedabad civic body implements smart queue system for property bill name transfers
news.para: Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation has launched the LogBook360 Smart Queue Management System across its seven zonal offices. This innovative digital tool simplifies the process of managing queues for services like property tax name transfers. Citizens can now effortlessly secure instant tokens from self-service kiosks, benefitting from QR code check-ins and live updates on their queue status, leading to enhanced transparency and more efficient service delivery.

news.title: ASK Property Fund invests ₹300 crore in residential projects in Ghaziabad
news.para: ASK Property Fund has allocated ₹300 crore towards two residential projects in Ghaziabad, showcasing its commitment to urban development. In a strategic move, the fund has exited a Chennai project, securing a profit of ₹340 crore. Additionally, a ₹500 crore platform partnership with Bhumika Group has been established, focusing investments in real estate across the National Capital Region, with ₹125 crore designated for a plotted development in Faridabad.

news.title: Mahindra Lifespaces to sell stakes in four associate companies for up to ₹80 crore
news.para: Mahindra Lifespace Developers has approved the sale of its entire stake in four associate companies to Omega Warehouse Holdings 2. Upon completion of the transaction, Ample Parks and Logistics, Ample Parks Project 1, Ample Parks Project 2 and Ample Parks MMR will cease to be associates of the company.
